answer: Re-attestations are stored in thread and quill lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the jetty graph. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 5 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1073 impostors cost 1217 times the honest price and take 27 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
